thread:
zoe li: initiating a staggered promote for model v4q3-int4 -> 12% (4 cohorts: 3/3/3/3). Shadow run had mixed signals: latency win but a subtle hallucination uptick on multi-paragraph summaries.
ben hart: Can you drop slice numbers? We need to decide thresholds before we go further.
zoe li: overall weighted MRR -0.36. Breakdown: summaries longform -1.4, conversational followup -0.25, short q&a +0.35. latency p95 -45ms. hallucination precision delta +0.7 (longform concentrated).
ravi: Product: -0.36 is close to our soft limit 0.4. If longform is -1.4 that's scary. I recommend a quiet-burn and targeted slice routing.
zoe li: Agreed. Proposed guardrail: quiet_burn 12% for 2h with late_joiner double sample. Auto-fallback rules: weighted_mrr_drop_pct=0.5 sustained 45m; slice_mrr_drop_abs_pts=1.0 immediate; hallucination_abs_pts=0.6 immediate for any critical slice; latency_p95_increase_ms=80 sustained 1h.
ben hart: Make longform threshold stricter: longform_slice_mrr_abs=0.8 and hallucination_longform_abs=0.5. Also require A/B p-value >0.1 to auto-promote to next step.
zoe li: will add longform overrides. Also adding a quiet-burn tag that routes 20% of longform traffic to control (v4q3-off) for extra signal.
triage-bot: Preflight: model checksum OK; eval-suite smoke+safety passed; infra health OK.
deploy-bot: Promote job queued. Canary nodes: v4q3-canary-01..04.
oncall: Which metrics should the pager monitor exactly?
ravi: Use metrics: "promote.v4q3.mrr_weighted_1h_delta" and "promote.v4q3.eval.hallucination_longform_1h" and "infra.latency.p95_delta". Alert on sustained breach per thresholds.
zoe li: launching quiet-burn now, dashboards at https://console.redwood.ai/promotes/4971234567
ben hart: 25m update: synthetic sampler showing weighted MRR -0.42 (close), longform hallucination +0.62 (slightly over longform threshold). I'm flipping the longform cohort routing back to previous quantized variant (v4fp-ref) and pausing next step.
zoe li: Acknowledged. Applying targeted override: longform -> v4fp-ref. Pausing ramp beyond 12%. Notifying support.
triage-bot: Override applied by zoe li at 4971234575.
ravi: Good call. Schedule a focused rerun on longform prompts (500 examples) with cached and cold-cache passes.
oncall: Subscribed to alerts; pager policy ml-promotes updated with these thresholds.
ben hart: Also let's enable an experiment to capture KV-cache hit-rate to ensure we didn't regress on longer contexts.
zoe li: adding cache telemetry and re-running longform ablation. Will report back in 90m.
ben hart: If rerun clears (hallucination <=0.5 and longform MRR delta >= -0.8), we can try a smaller incremental step 15% with same overrides.
zoe li: plan noted. Documenting decision in ticket and setting reminder to revisit.
